// REQ: LANG-2121 LANG-2122 LANG-2123 LANG-2124
// Failed requests per hour
let threshold = 5;
requests
| where timestamp > ago(1d) and success == false
| extend path = tostring(split(url, "?")[0])
| summarize failures = count() by bin(timestamp, 1h), path
| where failures > threshold
| order by failures desc
| render timechart
